decisions.reason: Turnaround management software has a dedicated page, sits close to the core offer and is central to the announced data-driven direction, so the visible commitment and sunk investment keep it firmly on the market.
Apron connectivity is foundational to the integrated digital platform, and slow uptake is still attributed to long airport procurement cycles, so management persists.
Billing software is less central to airside operations, but it builds on the established offer and complements the software and service expansion, so the firm gives it more time.
Equipment monitoring draws on the installed base and supports the announced lifecycle service strategy, so the firm keeps investing in it.
Resource management is close to the core and integral to the end-to-end operations suite, so its strategic fit and sunk investment favour keeping it.
The controller safety alert service supports the tower and safety positioning, and adoption in air traffic control is slow by nature, so weak early results are seen as temporary.
